fact: Digital expert Hervé Tiwa says Cameroon currently has a legal gap on malicious AI use (deepfakes, disinformation) that the cybercrime law must be extended to fill.

Gefona Digital Foundation says Cameroon's mechanisms are not AI-specific but general cybercrime and false-news law (Law 2010/012), and that the AI authority and legal framework called for by the July 2025 SNIA strategy do not yet exist.
